description: This Java class implements an Android IntentService that handles file transfer over WiFi Direct by establishing a socket connection to send a file specified by a content Uri. It manages socket creation, connection, and closing, and coordinates reading the file content from the device's ContentResolver.

classes.name: FileTransferService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles transferring a specified file over a socket connection in a WiFi Direct environment.

methods.name: FileTransferService(String name)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a name.

methods.name: FileTransferService()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the service with a default name.

methods.name: onHandleIntent(Intent intent)
methods.description: Handles the intent triggered to send a file. Establishes socket connection and streams the file to a peer device.
